PseudoTxSwitch.channelIsReversedClickToRestore: Channel is reversed - click to restore
PseudoTxSwitch.thenMoveTheStickOrFlick: , then move the stick or flick the switch you want on that channel. Unassigned channels hold 1500.
PseudoTxSwitch.theBrowserHasAppliedItsStandard: The browser has applied its standard gamepad layout to this device, which keeps only four axes and drops the rest - so the switches never arrive. Re-plug with the handset already in USB Joystick mode, or use a model whose USB descriptor is not recognised as a game controller.
PseudoTxSwitch.looksLikeAGamepadNotA: - looks like a gamepad, not a handset
PseudoTxSwitch.trainerSessionActiveTheTrainerOwns: Trainer session active - the Trainer owns the sticks
PseudoTxSwitch.sendsRcChannelsOverrideToThe: Sends RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE to the connected vehicle. The joystick WILL command the aircraft.
PseudoTxSwitch.offSendsNothingToTheAircraft: Off - sends nothing to the aircraft
PseudoTxSwitch.offTheSlidersBelowAreDriving: Off - the sliders below are driving RC
PseudoTxSwitch.waitingForAHandsetSetEdgetx: Waiting for a handset - set EdgeTX to USB Joystick mode
